release_notes_summary: Choose the update ZIP download folder and filename with Save As.
notes: Download Update opens Save As on the computer running the application. Choose the folder and ZIP filename.
Cancel stops the download. Successful verification shows the full saved path; Open Download Folder opens the chosen folder.
SHA-256 verification remains required before replacing the chosen destination. A failed verification preserves an existing file.
The automatic-download preference also prompts for a destination. Automatic installation remains disabled; close the app before manually replacing or staging the portable folder.
Includes the calculator and Searle improvements from 0.9.4.
Based on the preserved stable 0.9.4 source plus the approved Save As changes in the download service and About dialog.
Source base: 20fc45ea5032edb59ec86dba5495ba1694e8cdb5 plus approved working-tree changes.
49 focused updater service and UI tests passed. Package structure and all ZIP member hashes verified.
